blocks.text: 15-SEO / search engine optimization Goes here. A complete Shopify SEO guide focusing on the SEO cycle, keyword clustering, intent validation (commercial vs. informational), on-page optimization mapping (H1s, titles, descriptions), and content creation workflows using ChatGPT for blogs and product descriptions. Not here. • The technical setup of Shopify payment gateways or tracking -> 05-SET • Designing the landing page visual aesthetics -> 07-LPG

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details a practical monthly SEO cycle tailored for e-commerce, explicitly breaking down keyword clustering, commercial intent validation using Semrush, and mapping keywords to Shopify backend fields. modules: [SEO] topics: [keyword research, commercial intent, SEO cycle, on-page optimization, AI content generation, search engine listing] tier: 2 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. the SEO cycle / understanding SEO as a long-term gardening process, consisting of a monthly cycle: researching keywords, updating pages, feeding the search engine (adding content/blogs), and acquiring links; keyword strategy / moving away from single-keyword stuffing to "keyword clustering" (building relevance around a hero keyword with related cluster keywords); intent and validation / using Semrush (Keyword Magic Tool) to validate search volume (>1,000/mo), keyword difficulty (<40%), and commercial intent (indicated by a CPC > $1), explicitly avoiding high-difficulty informational keywords when trying to sell products; rank tracking / setting up projects in Semrush to track keyword position movements over time; on-page optimization / mapping keywords to Shopify's backend fields: Title (H1), Description (SEO paragraph containing hero and cluster keywords), and Search Engine Listing (optimizing the Title Tag and Meta Description to drive clicks, not just rank); feeding the search engine / maintaining relevance by publishing blogs, new products, and reviews; AI content creation / using ChatGPT to generate blog titles and articles by providing strict prompts defining the target audience (e.g., "environmentally conscious women under 30") and author persona (e.g., "handmade soap maker with 15 years experience"); AI detection / using tools like CopyLeaks to detect AI content and manually rewriting the last 10-20% to avoid Google's AI content penalties.

The Semrush Validation Rule: Only targeting keywords that meet specific criteria: Commercial intent (C), Volume >1,000, Keyword Difficulty (KD) <40%, and a Cost Per Click (CPC) >$1 (proving the keyword generates revenue).

The Search Engine Listing Tweak: Optimizing the Shopify Search Engine Listing (Meta Title and Description) not just with the keyword, but with a Call to Action (CTA) like "Fast Delivery" or "Buy Online" to optimize for the click-through rate.

The ChatGPT Persona Prompt: Instead of a generic prompt, explicitly instructing ChatGPT on the author's persona (e.g., "a soap maker with 15 years experience") and the audience's persona (e.g., "women 25-35 who are environmentally conscious") to generate non-generic blog content.
The Human Touch Rule: Mandating that AI-generated content must be checked against an AI detector (like CopyLeaks) and manually rewritten (10-20%) to prevent Google from de-ranking the site for spam.
Skip. The promotional pitch for the $99 SEO course and the Semrush free account bypass trick.
Scope mix. 100% baseline (standard Shopify SEO execution and planning). Volume. ~400 words.
